final_verdict_notes: The sealed selection is cryptographically intact, the protocol was frozen before generation, every candidate satisfies the frozen edit/mask/budget safeguards, and generation provenance is acceptable via a native Thermal_MPNN edit list plus a reproducible frozen rule (all decisive claims re-verified from native files in this review). The run is methodologically complete and honestly reports its failures. Scientific conclusions are strictly limited to in-silico predictions: no measured high-temperature activity, Tm, half-life, or significance is established; two of five finalists show only sub-noise numerical gains; catalytic metal-geometry checks are invalid on ion-free candidate models; and the act_seek safeguard and Boltz2 sanity check produced no result. Do not present these variants as experimentally improved.
